api_base.description:
Zscaler AI Guard API endpoint. Determines policy resolution behavior:
• /execute-policy (default) - Requires explicit policy_id in configuration
• /resolve-and-execute-policy - Infers policy from user-api-key-alias header
Default: https://api.us1.zseclipse.net/v1/detection/execute-policy
Falls back to ZSCALER_AI_GUARD_URL environment variable.

api_key.description: API key for Zscaler AI Guard authentication. If not provided, falls back to ZSCALER_AI_GUARD_API_KEY environment variable.

policy_id.description:
Global policy ID for Zscaler AI Guard. Required when using /execute-policy endpoint.

Set to 0 or leave empty when using /resolve-and-execute-policy with dynamic policy resolution.
Falls back to ZSCALER_AI_GUARD_POLICY_ID environment variable.

send_user_api_key_alias.description: Send user API key alias in request headers as 'user-api-key-alias'. CRITICAL when using /resolve-and-execute-policy endpoint - the policy is inferred from this value. Also useful for tracking/auditing with /execute-policy endpoint.

send_user_api_key_team_id.description: Send user API key team_id in request headers as 'user-api-key-team-id'. Enables team-level tracking and analytics in Zscaler AI Guard.

send_user_api_key_user_id.description: Send user API key user_id in request headers as 'user-api-key-user-id'. Enables user-level tracking and analytics in Zscaler AI Guard.

timeout.description: Timeout for each Zscaler AI Guard API call, in seconds. Must be positive. Raise it if scans fail under load with 'Connection timed out'. Defaults to 5 seconds.
